cpu-conversion.description: shipped defaults: GpuColorConversion=0 and GpuSourceConversion=0, so ffmpeg converts NV12->BGRA on the CPU inside the decoder child (4 B/px over the pipe and through the upload heap) and the capture readback is BGRA (4 B/px)

gpu-conversion.description: both GPU conversion paths on: the decoder delivers NV12 (1.5 B/px over the pipe and the upload heap, converted by PSSourceNv12 on the GPU) and the capture plane is read back as NV12 (1.5 B/px). This is the audit's largest proportional item and it is a policy default, not a code change
